name: Swatch Book
description: Strips from an ink swatch book, two to a cell, each one color stepped down from solid through four lighter tints, with a rivet hole punched through the pale end.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 5%; right: 5%; top: 9%; height: 36%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @var(--chips), @var(--rivet); mask: @var(--chips), @var(--rivet); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 5%; right: 5%; top: 55%; height: 36%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @var(--chips), @var(--rivet); mask: @var(--chips), @var(--rivet); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --chips: linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 17.6%, transparent 17.6% 18.6%, #000000c2 18.6% 36.2%, transparent 36.2% 37.2%, #00000087 37.2% 54.8%, transparent 54.8% 55.8%, #0000004d 55.8% 73.4%, transparent 73.4% 74.4%, #00000026 74.4%); --rivet: radial-gradient(circle at 88% 50%, transparent 5.6%, #000 5.6%); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
